original_target.title: Global classical solutions of the spatially inhomogeneous Landau–Coulomb equation
original_target.area: Fluids, kinetic theory and continuum mechanics

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
scope_comparison: Original classical inhomogeneous Coulomb equation on T3 asks all large smooth rapidly decaying positive-near-ball data. Golding–Henderson current Theorem1.4 is Landau–Fermi–Dirac with Pauli cap0<=f<=1 and collision factors; its a priori bounds rely on this quantum structure. Homogeneous Coulomb global regularity, hard-potential singularities and conditional continuation do not give the target. Bounded current searches found no full match; not a certification of openness.
